exposure: Pre-pregnancy BMI (obesity: BMI >= 30, overweight: 25 < BMI < 30, normal BMI)
outcome: Maternal clinical outcomes (sepsis, acute respiratory distress syndrome, need for mechanical ventilation)
cohort: 202 pregnant women with confirmed SARS-CoV-2 infection from the REBRACO (Brazilian Network of COVID-19 in Pregnancy) multicenter study.
finding: Obesity was independently associated with worse clinical outcomes (sepsis, acute respiratory distress syndrome, need for mechanical ventilation) and adverse perinatal outcomes in pregnant women with COVID-19.
